.בוצע מחקר שחלק מהתקציר שלו מוצג לפניך
1 נספח
Objectives: To evaluate the efficacy of varenicline vs placebo
among African American adults who are light, moderate, and heavy
daily smokers.
Interventions: Participants were provided 6 sessions of
individualized counseling and were randomized (in a 3:2 ratio) to
receive varenicline (1 mg twice daily; n = 300) or placebo (n = 200)
for 12 weeks. Randomization was stratified by sex and smoking
level (light smokers: 1-10 cigarettes/d; moderate to heavy smokers:
>10 cigarettes/d).
Main Outcomes: The primary outcome was biochemically salivary
cotinine–verified smoking abstinence at week 26. The secondary
outcome was biochemically salivary cotinine–verified smoking
abstinence at week 12, with subgroup analyses for light smokers and
moderate to heavy smokers.
Results: Including in the analysis those lost to follow-up as
smokers, participants receiving varenicline were significantly more
likely than those receiving placebo to be abstinent at week 26 (15.7%
vs 6.5%; difference, 9.2% [95% CI, 3.8%-14.5%]; odds ratio [OR], 2.7
[95% CI, 1.4-5.1]; P = .002).

 polypharmacyאו מטופלים בתרופות שמעלות סיכון

הצורך (פרקינסון ,אורתוסטטיזם ,נוירופאתיה סכרתית)
• יעוץ דיאטני לקשישים הסובלים מתת משקל  /תת תזונה.
התערבויות בקרב הצוות הרפואי:
• העלאת המודעות לאיתור מקרים בסיכון לנפילות
